119. Delimitation of territorial constituencies.—

—   The   Government   shall,   by 
notification,— 
[(a) divide the area within the jurisdiction of North Goa Zilla Panchayat and 
South Goa Zilla Panchayat into 30 and 20 single member territorial constituencies 
respectively, for the purpose of election, to such Zilla Panchayat.] 
(b) determine the territorial constituencies or constituencies in which seats are 
reserved for the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Backward Classes and Women.
